name: personajury
description: A persona jury as an engine: briefs, verdicts refused without evidence, scores per stratum. Local; never calls a model.
long_description: PersonaJury writes the briefs, refuses any verdict without evidence and reports scores per stratum, never averaged. It calls no model and no network: the app you chat in runs the personas. Claude Desktop has no subagents, so one context plays every juror; runs made here are labelled sequential, and `personajury_apply_check` answers advise for them, never apply. Pick the project folder that holds (or will hold) `.personajury/`.

root.title: Project folder
root.description: The project folder that holds .personajury/ (the store, the briefs, the verdicts). Desktop's working directory is not your project, so pick it here.

tools.name: personajury_brief
tools.description: Write one deterministic, hashed brief per persona and create the run

tools.name: personajury_verdict
tools.description: Ingest one persona's verdict; refused without evidence

tools.name: personajury_graph
tools.description: The jury as one static SVG

tools.name: personajury_should_run
tools.description: Whether a change needs a jury, from rules you write

tools.name: personajury_apply_check
tools.description: apply, escalate, human or advise, with the reasons
